info.name: FlashSale Service API
info.description:
FlashSale Service — authentication, time-slotted flash sales, seller rules, platform admin and warehouse sync.

**How to use**
1. Start the stack: `docker compose up -d --build` (demo data is seeded automatically).
2. Import this collection and the environment `FlashSale.local.postman_environment.json`; select the environment.
3. Run folder **0. Setup** (logs in demo buyer / seller / admin and stores tokens).
4. Run folders 2–5 in order (or the whole collection with the Runner). Folder 1 needs one manual step (OTP).

All IDs, tokens, idempotency keys and dates are captured automatically into collection variables.
Errors are RFC 7807 JSON with a stable `code` and a `correlationId`. Full reference: `{{baseUrl}}/swagger-ui.html`.

item.name: 0. Setup — log in demo accounts
item.description:
Logs in the seeded demo accounts and stores their access tokens in collection variables
(`buyerToken`, `sellerToken`, `adminToken`). **Run this folder first.**

A random demo buyer (buyer0001…buyer0200) is picked each run so repeated runs are not blocked by the
"1 flash-sale product per user per day" rule.

request.description:
Log in as a random seeded buyer (`buyerNNNN@demo.flashsale.dev`, password `Secret123`).
Stores `buyerToken` and `buyerEmail`.
Log in as the seeded seller of VN. Stores `sellerToken`.
Log in as the seeded platform admin of VN. Stores `adminToken`.

item.name: 1. Auth — register, OTP, login, refresh, logout
item.description:
Full lifecycle of a **new** account. Email vs phone is detected from `identifier`
(phone must be international, e.g. `+84912345678`).

**Manual step:** after *Register*, read the OTP and put it in the collection variable `otp`:
```
docker compose logs app | grep MOCK
docker compose exec redis redis-cli HGET otp:register:<email> code
```
Then run *Verify OTP* and the rest of the folder.

request.description:
Creates an unverified buyer + wallet and sends an OTP (mocked: app log / Redis).
Always answers **202** with the same message, whether or not the identifier already exists (no account enumeration).
A random email is generated into `newUserEmail`.

To register another account, clear the collection variable `newUserEmail`.

exec: console.log('Now set collection variable otp from: docker compose logs app | grep MOCK');

request.description: Sends a fresh code to an unverified account. 60 s cooldown per identifier (within the cooldown nothing is sent, still 202).

Activates the account. Codes are single use, valid 5 minutes, invalidated after 5 wrong attempts.
**Set `otp` first** (see folder description).

Returns a 15-minute JWT access token and a rotating refresh token.
Unknown user and wrong password give the same `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS`; an unverified account gets `403 ACCOUNT_NOT_VERIFIED`.
Profile of the token owner; email/phone are masked.
Rotates the refresh token (the old one stops working). Re-using an already rotated token revokes every session of the user.
Blacklists the access token (in Redis, until it expires) and revokes the given refresh token.
The logged-out token is rejected by every instance.

item.name: 2. Flash sale — buyer
item.description: Browse the live flash sale and buy. Needs `buyerToken` from folder 0.

request.description:
Products on flash sale **right now**, grouped by slot. Public: anonymous callers pass `region`.
Cached ~2 s per region, so `remaining` may lag slightly. Stores the first item with stock left in `itemId`.

exec: pm.test('a live slot exists (demo data: 24 slots/day)', () => pm.expect(items.length).to.be.above(0));

request.description: With a Bearer token the region comes from the token.

Buys one unit. Allowed only while the item's slot is live; **1 flash-sale product per user per region-local day**.
Header `Idempotency-Key` (generated into `idempotencyKey`) makes retries safe.

Responses: `201` bought (order PAID, balance debited) · `409 SOLD_OUT / ALREADY_PURCHASED_TODAY / FLASH_SALE_NOT_ACTIVE`
· `422 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE` · `429` rate limit.

exec: else { console.log('409:', pm.response.json().code, '(random buyer may already have bought today — rerun folder 0)'); }

request.description: Same `Idempotency-Key` → **200** with the original order, no second charge.

item.name: Purchase again, new key (1 per day)

request.description: A second purchase on the same day → **409 ALREADY_PURCHASED_TODAY** (enforced by PK (user_id, purchase_date)).

item.name: 3. Seller — products, stock, flash-sale rules
item.description:
A seller manages **own** products and schedules them into flash-sale windows with recurring rules
(slot start time × weekdays × price × quota per slot). Needs `sellerToken` from folder 0.
Rules created here target **tomorrow** (region-local), so the occurrence can be seen and withdrawn before it starts.

request.description: Window length and active weekdays — rule start times must match the windows.
Creates a product with initial stock. SKU unique per region (random SKU generated). Stores `productId`.
`total = available + reserved` per product.
Adds stock. Re-sending the same `Idempotency-Key` does not add stock twice.

item.name: Restock retry, same key (no double add)

request.description: Same key → stock unchanged.

"Put this product in the **21:00** window on **tomorrow's weekday**, 2,500,000, 30 units per slot."
Occurrences are generated immediately and the quota is reserved from stock. Stores `ruleId`.
Active and paused rules.
Concrete slot items generated from the rules for a region-local day. Stores the new occurrence in `occurrenceId`.
Not-yet-started occurrences are regenerated from the new rule; running slots are never touched.
Future occurrences removed, reserved stock returned.
Occurrences regenerated.
Occurrence ids change after update / resume.

exec: const mine = pm.response.json().filter(i => i.ruleId == pm.collectionVariables.get('ruleId') && i.status === 'APPROVED');

request.description: Skip a single occurrence before its slot starts; its reserved quota returns to available stock.

Price / status changes sync to flash sales asynchronously (`PRODUCT_CHANGED` event): rules whose sale price is no longer
below the product price are paused; `"status": "INACTIVE"` pauses all rules and blocks purchases immediately.

item.name: 4. Platform admin — schedule, slots, inventory, outbox
item.description: Platform admin of VN. Needs `adminToken` from folder 0.

request.description: Default: every day, 60-minute windows → 24 slots/day, 2 days ahead.
Changes apply to slots generated from now on (existing slots kept). Body shown with the default values.

item.name: Slots of tomorrow, grouped by seller

request.description: Every slot with each seller's items.
Normally runs every 10 minutes. Idempotent.
Stock vs. movement ledger for every product + outbox lag. `allConsistent: true` expected.
Events that failed 10 times. Retry with `POST /api/v1/admin/outbox/{id}/retry`.

item.name: 5. Integrations — warehouse stock sync
item.description:
Machine-to-machine: the warehouse (WMS) pushes stock deltas with header `X-Api-Key` (= `WAREHOUSE_API_KEY` from `.env`;
set the environment variable `warehouseApiKey`). Idempotent per `(source, eventId)`.

request.description:
`delta` changes sellable stock only. Unknown SKU or a delta that would make available stock negative → `REJECTED`
(recorded, not applied).
Same event ids → `DUPLICATE` with the original outcome; stock unchanged.
Invalid key → 401.
